method: Built-in imagegen; neutral.png used as style reference. Original outputs preserved in this directory. Row-major poses: neutral, ah, oo, blink, smile, angry, afraid, unused neutral.

prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Reference image is STYLE ONLY: match detailed retro pixel art space pilot busts and dark navy background. Create ONE new character sprite sheet: East Asian man, 40s, short swept black hair, strong cheekbones, teal flight suit. Exactly 4 columns by 2 rows of equal square cells, no gutters, no text. Identical front-facing character, clothing, hair and pose across cells. Row-major: neutral closed mouth; conversational open AH mouth; rounded OO speaking mouth; blink closed eyes resting mouth; restrained closed lip smile; frustrated brows closed mouth; worried eyes closed mouth; neutral duplicate. Head and shoulder closeup, eyes at 44% cell height, mouth center 61%, nose centered 48% width. Keep face size and alignment identical across poses. Full head visible, no labels or borders.
